prompt.alinti: Someone just open sourced a tool that runs thousands of fake customers through your launch.
And over 73,000 people have started this already.
It's called Mirofish, and it predicts how people are going to actually react before you even launch your product.
Just give it your launch page, your price, or your ad, and ask it one thing.
Are people going to love this or ignore it?
And it's not just one AI giving you an opinion.
It builds a whole world of AI customers with different backgrounds
You want to test your launch?
Comment 'crowd' down below, and I will send you the link over in the DMs.

yontem.ne: AI tabanlı hedef kitlesi testleme aracı.
